pm-mcp-server/src/main/java/de/planmarsh.description: Daemon start-up: PmMcpd entry point, the Unix-socket binding, the native transport selection and the runtime context shared by the assembly.
Token authentication and request identity: the authentication mechanism, the identity providers and the registries of job tokens and device secrets (empty until the job runtime exists).
The MCP tool surface: the core tools (stubs for now), the hello tool, closed input schema generation and flat schema validation, and the sessionless initialize handling.
The optional web listener beside the Unix socket and its request handler.

purpose_reasoning: packaging produces the native binary pm-mcpd (native profiles); the module is an assembly, not a reusable library
responsibility: Quarkus assembly of the always-on daemon pm-mcpd: it wires the engine and runtime modules of pm-mcp-core into the MCP server on a Unix socket, the token identity and request security, the local runtime API, the credentials resource and the optional web listener. It holds wiring only; logic that needs no framework type belongs in pm-mcp-core.
responsibility_reasoning: pom description 'Daemon assembly, Quarkus native binary pm-mcpd'; packages runtime, tools, security, web, api and credentials; AssemblyHoldsWiringOnlyTest and the CLAUDE.md module rules
